pages.text: The $(item)Fanny Pack$() is a wearable belt item that holds up to $(bold)8 Manila Folders$(). Think of it as a portable filing cabinet you can wear at your hip.

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: $(bold)Right-click$() while holding the Fanny Pack to open its folder UI, showing all 8 folder slots.$(br2)With $(item)Curios$() installed, wear it in the $(thing)belt$() slot for hands-free access.$(br2)Each folder slot independently stores one item type at the folder's tier capacity. Folders can be moved freely between Fanny Packs and $(l:storage/filing_cabinet)Filing Cabinets$().

pages.title: No Upgrades
pages.text: The Fanny Pack does not accept any upgrades directly. Its capacity is determined entirely by the $(l:storage/manila_folder)Manila Folders$() it contains.$(br2)To increase storage, upgrade the individual folders inside, or swap them for higher-tier ones.
